name: Le Mans Predictions
summary: Dedicated forecasting for the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
description: Scaffolded on the shared MotorsportVerse core with working seams: a snapshot-backed DataSource implementing the core calendar/grid/results contract, a leakage-guarded prior-form Predictor, and a contract test suite asserting that nothing is fabricated while no feed is wired. This project OVERLAPS wec-predictions — Le Mans is a WEC round — and that overlap must be resolved before either is built, or the two will publish different numbers for one race. See the project README.
